title: Dispatch: 19.5.15 triage and repair in-force custody/combat-close defects (attempt 1)
description: Execute eshyra-o9bd.19.5.15 per its DESCRIPTION (nine items) and DESIGN (triage method, Captain's partial triage, repair rules). Record a per-item triage table (invariant, authority, reachability with caller file:line, consequence, verdict: DEFECT / no requirement) in bd notes BEFORE repairing. Repair confirmed defects; host memory: before npm run verify:worktree wait until pgrep -fc 'node .*verify-current-worktree' prints 0 or 1 (read-only; never kill). verify:worktree before commit; commit; notes; close this bead. No push/PR.
notes:
TRIAGE (19.5.15.1):
#1 DEFECT: close_combat_instance model-facing description says owned summon links are released; code (activeEffects.ts applyCombatClosureToEffects ~7139, rebindCombatantReferencesToActor) rebinds durable-bonded links to the campaign actor and releases only instance-only ones. Authority: ADR 0020 s3 / tool-contract truthfulness. Reachable: every model call sees the description. Repair: description only.
#2 DEFECT (low): closeCombatInstanceTool catches only EncounterCombatantError; ActiveEffectError (claim conflict, applyCombatClosureToEffects ~7118) falls to registry catch-all tool_error. Convention: effectToolError maps ActiveEffectError to effect_error. Rollback already correct (withTransaction). Reachable via model tool call. Repair: map via effectToolError.
#3 DEFECT: checkoutCharacterIntoCampaign records custody even if attach.ok false. ok:false reachable when sheet system==campaign system but system != dnd5e-srd (e.g. pathfinder campaign + pathfinder sheet passes assertSheetMatchesPack; importFinalizedCharacter returns correctionResult). CLI playCharacter.ts:282 checkoutIntoCampaign calls it then returns attach.ok=false yet custody is held with no live row. ADR 0012 'record custody only after a successful attach'. Repair: no custody on !attach.ok.
#4 DEFECT (core API; CLI-unreachable: CLI only checks out into a free pc slot via hasCanonicalCharacter/nextPlayerCharacterId/fork id): same campaign+slot re-checkout re-attaches registry head over campaign sheet, losing unsynced progress; ADR 0012 no-silent-loss/single-writer. Repair: refuse (CharacterCustodyError) when the held campaign copy differs from head; lossless re-checkout stays idempotent.
#5 DEFECT: registerNewCharacter appends a 'register' revision for an existing id (head overwritten, revision 1 no longer the initial register; ADR 0012 linear timeline). Reachable via public core API/CLI migration/wizard. Repair: throw CharacterCustodyError if id already has head/timeline; ensureRevisioned (legacy head-only seed) uses appendRevision directly.
#6 DEFECT: forkCharacterTimeline guard uses headRevision only; legacy head-only id (registry.save, no revisions) would be overwritten by writeHead; its own docstring says a fork must never overwrite an existing character. Repair: also refuse when registry.load(newId) defined.
#7 no requirement: resume apply phase is documented two-phase (prompts, then apply); each applied step is an independently valid ADR 0012 resolution leaving a recoverable state (custody held, re-resumable); no accepted doc promises multi-character atomicity.
#8 no requirement: ADR 0012 explicitly says helpers never span DBs atomically and order writes for crash-recoverability (sync-back, chronicle, clear custody); no doc promises one transaction.
#9 no requirement: crash between createCampaign and startSession leaves a campaign resumable via launch; no invariant/doc promises atomic demo creation.
COMPLETION: commit 0d16fc9617de96cbca34eb441354da6040757f86. Repairs #1-#6 as triaged (#7-#9 no requirement). Tests: characterCustody.test.ts 'custody repairs' block (4 tests), new closeCombatInstanceToolErrors.test.ts (2); all 6 fail on pre-repair src. verify:worktree passed (6408 tests). Inventory file deterministicCapabilityInventory.ts absent in this tree (PR #643 unmerged); statements to change: close_combat_instance 'owned summon links released' (durable links are rebound), close_combat_instance error mapping, custody checkout idempotent-same-slot claim (now refuses when unsynced progress would be overwritten), registerNewCharacter/forkCharacterTimeline existing-id guards. Not pushed.
TRIAGE items 10-14:
#10 DEFECT (minor): refresh_effect description 'spell-grounded effect keeps its record duration' overclaims; refreshEffect (activeEffects.ts ~6219-6245) checks only when duration supplied, source spell, record parses timed. Authority: ADR 0020 s3 tool-contract truthfulness. Repair: description states the real scope.
#11 DEFECT: stripTrailingModelRollLedger regex unanchored; 'Rolls:' mid-line + newline drops the rest of player-visible narration. Reachable on every narration. Repair: anchor to line start.
#12 DEFECT: removeOptionGrants (called levelUpEngine ~1671 on option replace) removes a skill/save/armor that a still-held source also confers (ledger recorded nothing for it). Repair: removeOptionGrants takes still-held sources; shared items stay and provenance moves to that source's ledger entry; call site passes sources.
#13 DEFECT (low): materializeSnapshot contract 'refuses to overwrite an existing destination' but existsSync then renameSync replaces a destination created in between. Repair: publish via hard link (EEXIST -> CheckpointError), rename fallback only where links unsupported.
#14 no requirement: long-rest adjustHp refusal rolls back the whole rest transaction (fail-closed, all-or-nothing); no doc promises partial group rests; unreachable today.
COMPLETION (items 10-14): commit c56591eaf52bf31e031ff7ec6229deba3db472c0. Repairs #10-#13; #14 no requirement. Tests: proficiencyGrants.test.ts, playerVisibleRollLedger.test.ts, new checkpointRestoreRace.test.ts, closeCombatInstanceToolErrors.test.ts; all 4 fail pre-repair. verify:worktree passed. Inventory statements changed: refresh_effect duration claim; roll-ledger strip; proficiency removal semantics (shared grants retained, provenance moved); checkpoint restore no-clobber. Not pushed.
INVENTORY UPDATE (PR #643 merged in; commit 510274326abc365aa65ce108e4146ea35672a136; deterministicCapabilityInventory.ts). Before -> after, citations:
- close_combat_instance exclusion 'conflicting durable claims refuse whole close' + 'reported as effect_error result': toolCloseCombatInstance.ts:90 (effectToolError). Summon-link rebinding already described correctly (activeEffects.ts applyCombatClosureToEffects ~6878-7140).
- refresh_effect: inventory already matched code (activeEffects.ts ~6219-6245); unchanged.
- character-checkout-v1: 'records custody whenever attach returns incl. ok:false' -> no custody on ok:false (characterCustody.ts:228); 'same-slot re-checkout not refused, overwrites' -> idempotent only when stripped campaign copy equals head, else refused (characterCustody.ts:190-215); operation 'after the attach returns' -> 'succeeds'.
- registry store: 'registerNewCharacter does not refuse existing id' -> refuses registered id (characterCustody.ts:121); legacy seeding via appendRevision (characterCustody.ts:150).
- character-timeline-fork-v1: legacy head-only target 'not refused' removed; refuses head row too (characterCustody.ts:765-767).
- roll ledger strip: 'first Rolls: followed by line break' -> line-leading Rolls:, mid-line kept (playerVisibleRollLedger.ts:327).
- proficiency removal: added still-held-source retention + provenance move (proficiencyGrants.ts:166-200; levelUpEngine.ts:1671).
- checkpoint-store-v1: restore destination re-checked at hard-link publish (store.ts:130,144-146).
Closure test deterministicCapabilityInventory.test.ts passes; MODULE_DISPOSITIONS untouched (no module added/removed). verify:worktree passed.
